release_note: Year of the public v0.5.0 release of the rewritten language. The creator also records an earlier v0.3.0 predecessor around April 2011; 2012 does not mean that development or every earlier release began then.
definition: Public release of the rewritten language underlying the current Elixir implementation; not first commit or v1.0.

primary_sources.title: Elixir v0.5.0 released
primary_sources.author: José Valim
primary_sources.finding: The dated announcement identifies v0.5.0 as the first release after the rewrite and acknowledges v0.3.0 around April 2011.

primary_sources.title: Development & team
primary_sources.finding: The official project history describes Elixir's creation as a 2012 research and development project.

review_method: Official primary pages read with the web service; no host runtime or network process launched.
